#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <sstream>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    string word;
    int max_len = 0;
    int count = 0;
    bool inside = false;

    for (char c : s) {
        if (c == '_') {
            if (!word.empty()) {
                if (inside) count++;
                else max_len = max(max_len, (int)word.length());
            }
            word.clear();
        } else if (c == '(') {
            if (!word.empty()) max_len = max(max_len, (int)word.length());
            word.clear();
            inside = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            if (!word.empty()) count++;
            word.clear();
            inside = false;
        } else {
            word += c;
        }
    }
    if (!word.empty()) max_len = max(max_len, (int)word.length());

    cout << max_len << " " << count << endl;

    return 0;
}
